Cash Held Limit (days)
fields.description: Cash may stay with a person this many days; after that the holder and the admin are alerted daily until it is deposited. An account's own Max Days Held overrides it (SP-116).

fields.label: Cheque Due Alert (days before)
fields.description: A postal cheque becomes Due this many days before its due date, and its holder, the collection owner and the admin are alerted (SP-118).

fields.label: Confirm Collected Cheques at Once
fields.description: On: a collected postal cheque posts its payment at once. Off: the payment waits for the admin in Confirmations (SP-118).

fields.label: Large Payment (alert the admin above)
fields.description: A customer payment above this amount is flagged to the admin when it is recorded (SP-114).

fields.label: Winch Discount Role
fields.description: Who may give a discount when winch money is collected, besides the admin. Empty: only the admin.

fields.label: Smart Power Winch Jobs Post
fields.description: When a winch or Jumbo job for a station or one of our centers is charged: on the job day, or when the admin confirms it.

fields.label: Worker Advance Repayment
fields.description: How a winch or Jumbo crew member repays an advance: deducted from each monthly salary, or in cash. Daily workers always repay in cash.

fields.label: Oil Change Interval (km)
fields.description: The default for a vehicle that has no interval of its own (SP-106).

fields.label: Oil Change Alert (km before)
fields.description: The driver and the winch manager are told when a vehicle is this close to its oil change (SP-106).

fields.label: Lock Login After (failed tries)
fields.description: That many wrong passwords in a row lock the account until the admin unlocks it (SP-36).
Used by installment plans (Release 2).
fields.label: Annual Cost of Money
Instalment Due Alert (days before)
fields.description: The collection owner is told this many days before a contract instalment falls due (SP-81).

fields.label: Post Referrer Commission At
fields.description: When a station's referrer commission posts as a payable to the referrer: at the deposit, at the technical close, or when the admin presses Post Commission (SP-177).

fields.label: Financial Centers
fields.description: The cost center each source posts to (SP-27). A station is never a cost center: its costs carry its project.

fields.label: Projects Center
fields.description: Station documents (payments, write-offs, advances, purchases for a station) post here, with the station's project.

fields.label: Showroom Center
fields.description: Showroom sales, cash box and showroom costs.

fields.label: Winch Center
fields.description: Winch jobs and costs (each vehicle may get its own child center).

fields.label: Jumbo Center
fields.description: Jumbo car jobs and costs.

fields.label: Indirect Pool Center
fields.description: Salaries, rent and general costs; split into stations monthly (SP-124).

fields.label: Consignment Low Balance (panels)
fields.description: A consignment container at or under this many panels alerts the admin and the main store keeper (SP-91).

fields.label: Count Schedule
fields.description: Each location here gets a count sheet at the start of every week or month, and its store keeper a task (SP-94).

fields.label: Station Tabs by Role
fields.description: Which tabs of the station record each role sees (SP-76). A user sees the tabs of all their roles. Amounts follow the station's role permissions; the Costs tab also needs a cost role.
